title: Code agents join prompt agents
summary:
Code agents, clearer chat-model controls, and Polli page renders landed alongside low-balance guidance and three community apps.

Authors can publish a callable agent from a public GitHub repository with a root-level `agent.ts`, using My Models, the agents API, or Polli CLI 0.1.14. Agent fixes also keep explicitly private prompt agents from becoming public on a previously queued date, preserve useful Responses errors, and stop the model catalog from presenting agents with unknown run costs as free.

A Quest contribution added `supported_parameters` to model discovery for 84 public Chat models and 34 fallback routes. Developers can check a route's reported controls before making a Chat Completions request; fallback routes get their own lists rather than borrowing the primary route's.

When the balance-notice option is enabled, eligible text requests with insufficient balance return an unbilled, zero-usage notice linking to Pollen top-ups and Quests instead of an HTTP 402. It covers plain text, Chat Completions, and Responses, including streaming; JSON modes, audio and media output, and API-key budget failures retain HTTP 402.

daily.title: Build agents from code
daily.text: Point My Models, the agents API, or Polli CLI 0.1.14 at a public GitHub repository with a root-level `agent.ts` to publish it as a callable model. Code agents can use model calls and MCP tools. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Check chat model controls
daily.text: Model discovery responses now include `supported_parameters` for public Chat models and fallback routes, so you can check reported controls before sending a Chat Completions request. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Render pages with Polli
daily.text: Polli's `render_visual(type="studio")` turns display data into React-and-Tailwind compositions and returns full-page screenshots. Tall pages come back in readable tiles.
